verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that Termius generates SSH keys in multiple algorithms (Ed25519, ECDSA, RSA, ML-DSA) with passphrase protection. The docs also describe exporting public keys to authorized_keys, which completes the password-less access workflow. Missing for 10: independent hands-on or community corroboration of the key generation and export workflow.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can generate SSH key pairs for password-less access to my servers

citations.quote: Termius can generate Ed25519, ECDSA, RSA, and ML-DSA keys.
Generate SSH keys, FIDO2 keys, and Biometric keys; Provide a convenient way to export the public keys to the `authorized_keys` file
Create and manage your SSH keys with passphrase protection.
